name: Taloqan

queries.query: Taloqan Afghanistan cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: Official Ministry of Urban Development and Housing material was found describing approval and monitoring of Taloqan strategic/detail/development plans, but no public cadastral parcel viewer or parcel service was found. The official Ministry of Justice PRMIS portal was also found, but its public access gate denied this non-Afghanistan request and the public JavaScript bundle showed authenticated property-registration workflows rather than an anonymous parcel map API.

queries.query: تالقان افغانستان کادستر نقشه زمین ثبت املاک رسمی
queries.result: The official Dari Ministry of Urban Development and Housing result confirms Taloqan planning activity, including detailed/development/strategic plans, but does not expose parcel geometry or a public cadastral service. The Ministry of Justice property-registration portal is official but externally access-restricted; no anonymous parcel response was available.

queries.query: تالقان کادستر نقشه پارسل زمین افغانستان
queries.result: No first-party public Taloqan parcel viewer or bounded parcel API response was located. Search results were limited to official planning/geodesy prose and general land-policy material, not a usable city parcel service.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: No local Taloqan registry/cadastre custodian with an accessible parcel map or API was evidenced.
